summary: The Salvation Army Summit County Area Services (Booth Manor) provides housing, supplies, and intensive case management for up to four families (single or married parents with minor children) experiencing homelessness due to job loss, housing loss, or eviction.  Families receive these services for four to six weeks and are required to participate in daily caseworker meetings and bi-monthly life skills classes.
